summary: Reproduced Qwen3.5 DFlash terminal capture position indexing past the decoder ModuleList, then added explicit support for the terminal pre-final-norm capture position and validation for positions beyond it. Qwen3-VL's existing HF-to-SGLang +1 mapping now accepts the last decoder layer and returns its residual-stream output.
